cover.title: Software built around territory, evidence and operations.
cover.subtitle: A compact visual atlas of geospatial products, applied tools and spatial systems.

projects.name: GeoPlatform
projects.description: A 2D/3D workspace for checking what is happening around a place: mining data, satellite imagery, weather, earthquakes, routes and field context.

projects.name: Pulso Público Argentina
projects.description: A public map of recent signals across Argentina: earthquakes, thermal detections, weather and national indicators, with the source and update time visible.

projects.name: Anti IA
projects.description: An evidence-first interface for territorial questions. Pick a case, see what is known, what is missing, what supports it and what question should come next.

projects.name: FleetFlow Sim
projects.description: A delivery fleet simulator set in Córdoba. Vehicles follow routes, stop at deliveries, carry packages and expose distance, fuel and fleet KPIs while the simulation runs.

projects.name: Atlas Geotech
projects.description: An interactive mining atlas for exploring Argentine projects by province, mineral, project stage, company and capital origin.

more_systems.title: Small tools, local systems and experiments.
more_systems.subtitle: A second layer of builds focused on workflows, question structuring, media production and agent experiments.

items.name: Opportunity OS
items.description: A local-first job-search system for finding opportunities, tracking target companies, generating evidence-backed CVs and organizing outreach.

items.name: Question Radar
items.description: A Python tool that turns questions into structured data and shows what assumptions, evidence or next questions are missing.

items.name: Screen2Social
items.description: A local pipeline that turns OBS screen recordings into a ready-to-post video, thumbnail, metadata and optional local transcript.

items.name: Geo Agent
items.description: A small geospatial agent experiment built around tools, external sources and validation instead of AI-only answers.
